class.name: RealityImageBasedLight3D
class.brief_description: Defines the ambient lighting of a Node and its descendants.
class.description:
RealityImageBasedLight3D is similar to WorldEnvironment, but it can be used anywhere in the scene, instead of being global. It affects its parent Node and all the descendants of that node.
This translates to a RealityKit [url=https://developer.apple.com/documentation/realitykit/imagebasedlightcomponent]ImageBasedLightComponent[/url].

members.member: The [Environment] resource used for image-based lighting. Its sky texture is converted to a RealityKit [url=https://developer.apple.com/documentation/realitykit/imagebasedlightcomponent]ImageBasedLightComponent[/url].
